name: Sudden Death Beam
findings: Triggers behind the attacker when hit by basic, Strike, or Ki Blast attacks; otherwise teleports without firing while still consuming Ki
Follow-up cannot be canceled into another Super according to the dedicated skill documentation
Current acquisition routes: TP Medal Shop, STP Medal Shop, Double Crystal Raid Battle
Independent Crystal Raid guidance describes it as an all-attack counter and slower than Counter Impact
Exact counter-active timing, damage, and frame data remain unresolved
